content_sections.heading: CSIR-IMTECH Project Research Scientist-III Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years. Candidates must meet one of these two routes: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with five years post qualification experience, or Ph.D. + two years post qualification experience. For Engineering/ IT/ CS: Four years Graduate degree with five years experience post qualification, or PG degree with three years post qualification experience, or Ph.D. A degree in data science or bioinformatics or computational biology In-depth knowledge of the molecular basis of antimicrobial resistance Previous experience with genomics and AI/ML Hands-on experience with LLMs (the notice calls this "highly desirable") Candidates whose results are awaited are not eligible to apply. If the Hindi and English versions of the notice differ, the English version will prevail. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts does CSIR-IMTECH advertise under Rolling Advt. No. 2026-10-06?
faq.answer: There is one post: Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical), with 01 vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly pay for Project Research Scientist-III at CSIR-IMTECH?
faq.answer: The post pays monthly emoluments of Rs. 78,000/-, plus HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply with a postgraduate degree and no Ph.D.?
faq.answer: Yes. A Post Graduate Degree, including an integrated PG degree, qualifies if you have five years of experience after the qualification. Ph.D. holders need two years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What do Engineering, IT or CS candidates need?
faq.answer: You need one of these: a four-year Graduate degree with five years of post-qualification experience, a PG degree with three years of post-qualification experience, or a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. Which skills give a candidate an edge?
faq.answer: The notice prefers a degree in data science, bioinformatics or computational biology, in-depth knowledge of the molecular basis of antimicrobial resistance, and experience with genomics and AI/ML. It calls hands-on experience with LLMs highly desirable.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply if my final result is still awaited?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that result-awaited candidates are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Which project will the Project Research Scientist-III work on?
faq.answer: The project is "Innovative technologies for detecting drug-resistant priority pathogens in India to improve patient outcomes", with Project Code GAP-0266.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR-IMTECH located?
faq.answer: The institute is at Sector 39-A, Chandigarh-160036. Here's the article for Rolling Advt. No. 2026-10-06 (1 post, Rs. 78,000/- + HRA, age limit 45). It's short because the one-page notice is short. Things to check before publishing: 1. **No application method.** The notice doesn't say how to apply, so I left out the "How to Apply" section rather than make up steps. The title still says "Apply Online" because that's the default. Please check the recruitment page and change the title if applications go by post or email. 2. **No last date or Important Dates.** It's a rolling advertisement with no last date, fee or selection process. One sentence under the first table says so, and the Application Fee, Important Dates and Selection Process sections are left out. 3. **"CSIR-IMTECH" short name.** The notice only prints "CSIR-Institute of Microbial Technology". The "IMTECH" short form comes from the website address.
